title: FRACTAL kernel BLUEPRINT
description: Harness-neutral epic contract. Installer extensions (model tiers, installer-specific directory paths, feature_lead names, router state) must not appear here.

name.description: Stable epic identifier (filename stem). Example: NOVA-P1-NotificationCore

date.description: ISO date the BLUEPRINT was authored

status.description: Epic-level lifecycle only. Workstream readiness is derived from accepted evidence, not this field.

revised.description: ISO date of the last revision. Equal to date when never revised.

trigger.description: Why this epic exists now — the request or milestone that opened it

source_documents.description: Paths or titles the Architect read before decomposing

locked_decisions.description: Decisions Feature Leads must not reopen

pending.description: Open questions that do not block listed workstreams

parallel.description: Execution-order waves only. Each wave is a list of workstream ids that may run concurrently once their depends_on evidence is accepted. Not a second dependency graph.

notes.description: Execution-order commentary only. Do not store installer routing, model tiers, or PRD status here.

id.description: Kebab-case workstream id. This is the only legal depends_on value.

depends_on.description: Workstream ids whose evidence must be accepted before this workstream is ready. Empty means ready when the epic is active.

acceptance.description: Epic-level acceptance bullets for this workstream. The PRD may refine them; it may not contradict them.
